description: This module provides functions for training machine learning models (Linear Regression and Random Forest), serializing/deserializing models, and making predictions. It interacts with a database to fetch datasets and store models and metrics, and manages datasets and model results objects.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _load_df(dataset: Dataset)
methods.description: Loads a dataset from the path stored in the Dataset object, raising an error if file not found.

methods.name: _prepare_xy(df: pd.DataFrame, target: str)
methods.description: Prepares feature matrix X and target vector y from a DataFrame for training, only including numeric features.

methods.name: str _serialize_model(model)
methods.description: Serializes a trained model to a base64-encoded string using temporary file storage.

methods.name: _deserialize_model(b64: str)
methods.description: Reconstructs a model object from a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: dict train_model(dataset_id: int, target: str, algorithm: str, db: Session)
methods.description: Trains a machine learning model (Linear Regression or Random Forest) on a specified dataset, computes metrics, serializes the model, and stores results in the database.

methods.name: predict_with_model(model_dataset_id: int, rows: list, db: Session)
methods.description: Loads a trained model from database and makes predictions on new input rows.
